body: Havneby åbner en ny cykelsti mellem stationen og havnen på lørdag. Kommunen har brugt to år på at forhandle med lodsejere langs ruten. Borgmesteren kalder stien et løft for både pendlere og weekendgæster.
translated: Havneby is opening a new cycle path between the station and the harbour on Saturday. The municipality has spent two years negotiating with landowners along the route. The mayor calls the path a boost for both commuters and weekend visitors.
summary: Havneby opens a new cycle path from the station to the harbour on Saturday after two years of talks with landowners.

body: Et kraftigt lavtryk rammer Nordvestjylland natten til torsdag og giver kuling og lokalt storm. Beredskabet i Klitsogn anbefaler at sikre løse genstande og holde sig fra kysten ved højvande. Færgen til Øholm aflyser to morgenafgange, hvis bølgerne overstiger tre meter. Kommunen åbner en varmestue i hallen for beboere uden strøm. Meteorologerne forventer, at vinden løjer af sidst på formiddagen.
translated: A strong low-pressure system will hit north-west Jutland on Thursday night, bringing gale-force winds and locally stormy conditions. Emergency services in Klitsogn recommend securing loose objects and staying away from the coast at high tide. The ferry to Øholm will cancel two morning departures if waves exceed three metres. The municipality is opening a warming shelter in the sports hall for residents without power. Meteorologists expect the wind to ease late in the morning.
summary: A Thursday-night storm in north-west Jutland may cancel Øholm ferry sailings; Klitsogn is opening a warming shelter and urging people to stay off the coast.

body: IF Havneby vandt 3-1 over Skovby FK og rykker op i 3. division. Målscorer Sara Lind scorede to gange i anden halvleg efter et hjørnespark og en kontra. Træneren fremhævede defensiven, der holdt stand i de sidste ti minutter. Omkring 800 tilskuere fyldte den lille tribune, og klubben åbner nu for nye medlemskort. Der er endnu ikke sat dato på første hjemmekamp i den nye række.
translated: IF Havneby beat Skovby FK 3-1 and is promoted to the 3rd division. Goalscorer Sara Lind scored twice in the second half from a corner and a counter-attack. The coach highlighted the defence, which held firm in the last ten minutes. About 800 spectators filled the small stand, and the club is now opening new memberships. A date has not yet been set for the first home match in the new league.
summary: IF Havneby won 3-1 against Skovby FK and is promoted to the 3rd division after two second-half goals from Sara Lind.

body: Byrådet i Klitsogn vedtog tirsdag et budgetforlig, der flytter 18 millioner kroner til ældrepleje og skoler. Forliget blev til efter tre natmøder mellem Socialdemokratiet, Venstre og det lokale listeparti Kystlisten. En planlagt omfartsvej ved Sønderby udskydes to år, og det sparede beløb går til flere sygeplejersker i hjemmeplejen. Skolelederne får midler til to ekstra læsevejledere og til at skifte de ældste computere. Kystlisten fik desuden gennemført et loft over gebyret for liggepladser i lystbådehavnen. Oppositionen stemte imod, fordi de mener, at vejen haster mere end hallens tag. Borgmester Ingrid Holm sagde efter afstemningen, at forliget er et kompromis, ikke en sejr. Hun lovede en offentlig gennemgang af anlægsplanen i januar. Flere borgere ventede uden for rådhuset med skilte om både vejen og ældreplejen. Budgettet træder i kraft 1. januar og kan kun ændres med et nyt flertal.
translated: The municipal council in Klitsogn on Tuesday adopted a budget agreement that moves 18 million kroner to elderly care and schools. The deal followed three night meetings between the Social Democrats, Venstre and the local list party Kystlisten. A planned bypass at Sønderby is postponed for two years, and the saved amount goes to more nurses in home care. School leaders receive funds for two extra reading coaches and to replace the oldest computers. Kystlisten also secured a cap on berth fees in the marina. The opposition voted against the deal because they believe the road is more urgent than the sports-hall roof. Mayor Ingrid Holm said after the vote that the agreement is a compromise, not a victory. She promised a public review of the capital plan in January. Several residents waited outside city hall with signs about both the road and elderly care. The budget takes effect on 1 January and can only be changed with a new majority.
summary: Klitsogn's council passed a budget deal shifting 18 million kroner to elder care and schools, delaying the Sønderby bypass for two years. Mayor Ingrid Holm called it a compromise; the opposition voted no.

body: Havneby Bibliotek udvider førstesalen med et stillezonerum og tre studiepladser. Projektet koster ca. 2,4 millioner kroner og finansieres bl.a. af en pulje fra Kulturstyrelsen og kommunens anlægsbudget. Bibliotekschefen siger, at rummet især skal bruges af studerende og af borgere, der arbejder hjemmefra. I en overgangsperiode flyttes børneafdelingen til kælderen, f.eks. i ugerne omkring efterårsferien. Der kommer også en ny indleveringsboks udendørs, så bøger kan afleveres, når huset er lukket. Åbningen er planlagt til marts, hvis leverancen af akustikplader holder tiden.
translated: Havneby Library is expanding the first floor with a quiet room and three study seats. The project costs about 2.4 million kroner and is financed among other things by a grant from the Agency for Culture and the municipal capital budget. The library director says the room is especially meant for students and for residents who work from home. During a transition period the children's section moves to the basement, for example in the weeks around the autumn holiday. There will also be a new outdoor returns box so books can be handed in when the building is closed. The opening is planned for March if the delivery of acoustic panels stays on schedule.
summary: Havneby Library will add a quiet room and study seats for about 2.4 million kroner, with a planned opening in March if materials arrive on time.

body: Havnefestivalen vender tilbage i august med tre dage på kajen. Programmet tæller lokale fiskere, der viser røgning af sild, en scene til folkmusik og en børneworkshop om knob. Kommunen advarer om begrænset parkering ved stationen og anbefaler toget. Sidste år kom omkring 12.000 gæster, og arrangørerne forventer lidt flere, hvis vejret holder. Øholm Færgefart sætter en ekstra aftenafgang ind lørdag. Salget af madboderlicenser åbner mandag, og foreningen prioriterer sælgere fra kommunen.
translated: The harbour festival returns in August with three days on the quay. The programme includes local fishers demonstrating herring smoking, a folk-music stage and a children's workshop on knots. The municipality warns about limited parking at the station and recommends the train. Last year about 12,000 guests came, and the organisers expect a few more if the weather holds. Øholm Ferry will add an extra Saturday evening departure. Sales of food-stall licences open on Monday, and the association gives priority to vendors from the municipality.
summary: The harbour festival returns in August with three days of music, fishing demos and workshops; organisers expect more than last year's 12,000 guests.

body: Klitsogn Skole får nye tagvinduer og et ventilationsanlæg i den gamle mellembygning. Arbejdet begynder i uge 28 og varer seks uger, så eleverne holdes på den nyere fløj. Forældrene har klaget over hovedpine og tør luft i to klasser siden januar. Entreprenøren er et lokalt firma, der også lagde tag på hallen. Skolebestyrelsen beder kommunen om midlertidige kølebokse til madordningen, mens køkkenet er afspærret. Rektor understreger, at eksamener i juni ligger før byggestart.
translated: Klitsogn School is getting new roof windows and a ventilation system in the old middle building. Work starts in week 28 and lasts six weeks, so pupils stay in the newer wing. Parents have complained about headaches and dry air in two classrooms since January. The contractor is a local firm that also reroofed the sports hall. The school board is asking the municipality for temporary cooling boxes for the meal scheme while the kitchen is closed off. The headteacher stresses that June exams take place before construction starts.
summary: Klitsogn School will replace windows and ventilation in week 28 after parent complaints about air quality; June exams are scheduled before the work.

body: Øholm Færgefart ændrer vintersejlplanen fra 1. november. Hverdage går færgen kl. 6.30, 11.00 og 16.15, mens søndagsafgangen kl. 9.00 droppes. Rederiet henviser til færre pendlere og til højere brændstofpriser. Pendlerforeningen kalder beslutningen et slag for øens unge, der læser i Havneby. Kommunen forhandler om et tilskud, så mindst én formiddagsafgang kan beholdes i januar og februar. Billetter købt før 15. oktober refunderes automatisk, hvis afgangen nedlægges.
translated: Øholm Ferry is changing the winter timetable from 1 November. On weekdays the ferry runs at 6.30, 11.00 and 16.15, while the Sunday departure at 9.00 is dropped. The company cites fewer commuters and higher fuel prices. The commuters' association calls the decision a blow for the island's young people who study in Havneby. The municipality is negotiating a subsidy so that at least one morning departure can be kept in January and February. Tickets bought before 15 October are refunded automatically if the departure is cancelled.
summary: Øholm Ferry will drop the Sunday 9.00 sailing from 1 November, citing fuel costs; the municipality is talking about a subsidy to keep a morning run.
